bio: Housed in Oerschen Hof, a spruce historical aristocratic palace in the city centre, this tastefully designed restaurant serves a contemporary take on classic cuisine, laying the focus squarely on the ingredients and skill of the chefs. The plating is refreshingly slick and uncluttered. Order à la carte or opt for a menu comprising four to seven courses. The charming and adept service team will be happy to advise you. Chef Karl-Nikolas Spitzner also gets involved in serving from time to time. In fine weather, make a beeline for the terrace....
